about: [O7] The revolver under my arm in the city (OPEN_WORLD §1; the cold play's finding 2: the title's verbs true): a new night gives it and a dozen rounds; the card '[WHEEL] the revolver' in a quiet second; the wheel draws it (the viewmodel, the gun mode); LMB fires on the press, a lamp post down the street is hit (O6's set answers: 'smash' by a bullet); the city answers the shot within the second (the heat's shields, 'Lose them.': O3's stand-in until its witnesses); R reloads from the coat; the wheel puts it away; drawn again and E at the car: put away, in the seat. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o7_gun.json

steps.label: a new night: the revolver under my arm, a dozen in the coat, not in hand

steps.name: (turned from the car: the card waits until I am not at it)

steps.label: on foot, away from the car, a quiet second: the card '[WHEEL] the revolver'
the wheel: drawn (in hand, the gun mode), the card gone

steps.eval: (() => { const S = G.stage.smash, p = N.controller.pos, g = G.night.graph(); const L = [...S.near(p.x, p.z, 30)].filter((i) => (i.kind === 'lamp' || i.kind === 'pole') && i.state === 'stand').sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - p.x, a.z - p.z) - Math.hypot(b.x - p.x, b.z - p.z)); const q = L.find((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - p.x, q.z - p.z) > 4 && (!g || !g.lineOfSight || g.lineOfSight(p.x, p.z, q.x, q.z))) || L[0]; if (!q) return null; window.__lamp = q; const d = Math.hypot(q.x - p.x, q.z - p.z); N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-(q.x - p.x), -(q.z - p.z)); N.controller.pitch = Math.atan2(1.3 - G.eye.y, d); window.__s0 = { ev: S.events.length, shots: G.counters.shots || 0 }; return [q.kind, q.id, +d.toFixed(1)]; })()

steps.label: LMB: fired on the press, a round gone
the city answers the shot within the second: the shields, 'Lose them.'

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ lamp: window.__lamp && [window.__lamp.kind, window.__lamp.state, window.__lamp.hits], ev: G.stage.smash.events.slice(window.__s0.ev).map((e) => [e.kind, e.what, e.by]) })

(() => { const c = G.city.car, p = N.controller.pos; const d = Math.hypot(c.pos.x - p.x, c.pos.z - p.z); if (d > 2.3) { const k = (d - 1.6) / d; N.controller.setPose(p.x + (c.pos.x - p.x) * k, p.z + (c.pos.z - p.z) * k, 0, 0); } N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - N.controller.pos.x), -(c.pos.z - N.controller.pos.z)); N.controller.pitch = -0.1; return G.player.weapons.current; })()

steps.label: drawn, then E at the car: put away, in the seat
